freeze_note: The policy, value, and gate definitions were frozen after only campaign completion status (128 of 384 runs) was inspected. The support amendment was made after the completed dataset exposed one zero-eligible-row source run and after the first policy invocation failed its hierarchy assertion; no policy value, latency result, airtime result, or qualification outcome was read.
purpose: Separate cross-family treatment-effect information from offline resource allocation before selecting an implementable closed-loop candidate.

support_amendment.reason: An action-clean eligible-row estimand has no per-run value for a source run containing zero retained eligible rows.
support_amendment.inspected_information: Dataset row coverage and source identity only
support_amendment.policy_value_rule: Condition each scenario's eligible-row policy value and run-cluster bootstrap on represented nonempty runs; preserve equal family and equal scenario weight.
support_amendment.resource_rule: Retain every source run in per-run action and reservation summaries, assigning zero actions and zero reservation to a zero-eligible-row run.
support_amendment.forbidden_shortcut: Do not assign a zero policy outcome to an empty eligible-row run and do not drop its source identity from the audit.

resource.budget_derivation: 12000 us initial credit plus 0.006 times 60000000 us refill
resource.cost_arithmetic: exact decimal text from the source dataset
resource.per_run_cost_invariant: at most one positive constant cost for each of I_FRAME and P_FRAME

predicted_objectives.deadline_rescue: max(T2 CDF at the row deadline minus control CDF at the row deadline, 0)
predicted_objectives.tail18_acceleration: max(T2 CDF at 18000 us minus control CDF at 18000 us, 0)
predicted_objectives.primary_deadline_risk: 1 minus control CDF at the row deadline

policies.action_rule: Within each run, order all rows by the unsigned random key then frame_id and greedily admit a row exactly when its decimal canonical cost fits the remaining budget.
policies.evaluation_rule: Average the 64 deterministic action indicators per row before known-propensity policy-value evaluation; also report across-replication resource and point-value spread.

policies.information: LOFO cross-fitted potential completion distributions and pre-action canonical costs only

exact_two_cost_knapsack.candidate_rule: A row is a candidate iff its primary reward is positive or its secondary reward is positive.
exact_two_cost_knapsack.enumeration: Enumerate every feasible I-frame prefix count; for each count take the longest affordable positive P-frame prefix.

deadline_miss.estimator: known-propensity doubly robust potential CDF at each row's deadline

completed_late18.definition: finite observed union completion latency strictly greater than 18000 us
completed_late18.estimator: known-propensity Horvitz-Thompson because the frozen finite-threshold CDF does not distinguish incomplete outcomes from every completion above 41667 us

bounded_tail_diagnostic.definition: completion after 18000 us and no later than the row deadline
bounded_tail_diagnostic.estimator: known-propensity doubly robust difference between row-deadline CDF and 18000-us CDF

policy_value.canonical_reservation: deterministic exact sum of selected source reservation text

uncertainty.family_strata: keep all six families fixed and equally weighted
uncertainty.within_family: sample the family's 16 scenarios with replacement
uncertainty.within_scenario: for each sampled scenario, sample its represented nonempty whole-run replicates with replacement using a sample size equal to its represented replicate count

go_no_go.interpretation: If the identified resource ceiling fails, change the action space; if it succeeds, continue with a nested, nonclairvoyant allocator and then actual held-out closed-loop qualification.

interpretation_limits: Every learned score for a held-out family comes from models trained without that entire family.
The resource oracle sees the complete sequence of cross-fitted predicted scores in a run and is not an implementable controller.
Randomized replay does not reproduce queue, collision, or interference feedback induced by a closed-loop policy.
The dataset excludes startup and action-dirty temporal rows, so its absolute rate is not an all-generated-frame qualification result.

One source run has zero retained eligible rows; policy values condition on the three represented runs in that scenario, while resource summaries retain the empty source run at zero action and reservation.
Actual held-out-family simulation is required before promoting any controller.
Completed-frame P99 remains a closed-loop metric and is not inferred from the finite CDF grid.
